101-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

224-1772-3756-8345.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

643-2511-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-2511-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-4716-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-4716-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

240-728-4927-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-4927-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2511-5933.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

277-851-2557-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-7290-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
539-3899-4552-7290-7803.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-3715-5365-7810.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-5365-7810.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating a Clue and Food artifact token.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clue and Food, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-2665-4865.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-2665-4865.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Vesuvan Shapeshifter and Progenitor Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Vesuvan Shapeshifter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Progenitor Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-2665-4865.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-539-3043-7781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures with defender.
215-539-3043-7781.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Axebane Guardian
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4013-4872-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Eldrazi Displacer.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

997-7084-7316.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
997-7084-7316.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Rat King and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-4885-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

955-1719-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1483-5686-6972--112.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Weaponcraft Enthusiast.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Weaponcraft Enthusiast enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
1483-5686-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

222-527-2511-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2511-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

2173-3944-5220-6578.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
2173-3944-5220-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

1680-4365-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with power 4 or greater.
2-6556.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

560-2558-5330-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

112-198-4067-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}
Shantotto triggers, giving it +4/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator
Repeat.

1061-1576-6568.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-6568.notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-6568.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Y'shtola Rhul triggers, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

856-5315-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

575-2511-5971.notablePrerequisites: Zimone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
575-2511-5971.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing it.
When Bloodflow Connoisseur dies, Yedora triggers, returning Bloodflow Connoisseur from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Bloodflow Connoisseur enters the battlefield as a Forest land, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning the creature face-up.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, doing nothing.
Repeat.
575-2511-5971.notes: You may instead sacrifice a different creature to get the infinite sacrifice outlet products.

1651-3715-5365-5902.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-5365-5902.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

2104-2239-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Ardent Elementalist.
2104-2239-2665.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
When the token Ardent Elementalist enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Blossoming Tortoise

539-624-4385-4552.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {0}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Repeat.

57-2178-3621-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon of the Third Path.
Feldon of the Third Path does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-3621-4050.description:
Activate Feldon of the Third Path by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token, adding {R}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it and Feldon of the Third Path trigger.
Resolve the Feldon of the Third Path trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

933-1530-3544-5049.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
933-1530-3544-5049.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another Angel you control

3259-4068-4302-4509.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent is unable to block creatures you control.
You control an additional Angel.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4068-4302-4509.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach it to another Angel you control, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token due to Divine Visitation.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat each combat phase.

586-671-2034-2693.description:
Cast Priest of Gix.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Daxos triggers, gaining you 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix to add {C}{C}.
Daxos triggers, gaining you 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life to return Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4050-4499-4840.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, exiling Myr Battlesphere and then returning it to the battlefield.
Myr Battlesphere triggers, creating four 1/1 colorless Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Myr token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 3 two more times.
Repeat.

195-427-1812.notablePrerequisites:
You have drawn five or more cards this turn.
Kydele does not have summoning sickness.
195-427-1812.description:
Cast Chain Stasis targeting Kydele.
Pay {2}{U} to copy Chain Stasis.
Holding priority on Chain Stasis, activate Kydele to make {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Holding priority on Chain Stasis, pay {C}{C} to activate Prismite, adding {U}.
Let the copy of Chain Stasis resolve.
Repeat steps 2-5.

2492-2751-4276.notablePrerequisites: You control artifacts that can produce at least {2}.
2492-2751-4276.description:
Cast Bonus Round by paying {1}{R}{R}, creating an ability that will trigger each time a player casts an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When you cast Turnabout, the ability created by Bonus Round in step 1 triggers.
In response, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying the ability from Bonus Round.
Resolve the copied ability, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping Strionic Resonator and all other artifacts you control.
Activate artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
If you can add at least {3} in step 7, this combo produces infinite mana.
